description: This file defines the SlotsOutputService class responsible for managing and retrieving available and reserved slot information, including handling timezone adjustments and seat availability, within a scheduling or booking system.

classes.name: SlotsOutputService_2024_09_04
classes.description: Service class for handling slot availability and reservation logic, including timezone adjustments and seat management.

methods.name: getAvailableSlots
methods.description: Main method to retrieve available slots, either time-based or range-based, depending on the format.

methods.name: getAvailableTimeSlots
methods.description: Retrieves individual available time slots, adjusting for timezone and seat availability.

methods.name: getAvailableTimeSlot
methods.description: Creates a slot object for a specific start time.

methods.name: getAvailableTimeSlotSeated
methods.description: Creates a seated slot object with seat count and booking info.

methods.name: getAvailableRangeSlots
methods.description: Retrieves range-based slots, adjusting for timezone, duration, and seat availability.

methods.name: getAvailableRangeSlot
methods.description: Creates a range slot object for start and end times.

methods.name: getAvailableRangeSlotSeated
methods.description: Creates a seated range slot object with seat count and booking info.

methods.name: getReservationSlot
methods.description: Generates reservation details from a selected slot, including start, end, duration, and UID.

methods.name: getReservationSlotCreated
methods.description: Generates reservation creation details with specified duration.
